I've now gathered a comprehensive view. Let me synthesize:

The codebase is in a post-migration state from the prior task "03-move-agent-scratch-under-relay". The agent prompt and screenshot tool now point to `.relay/scratch/`. But there are two remaining deletion sites that actively remove `.relay-scratch/` — and six exclusion lists that treat it as a protected internal artifact.

The task says "we don't need to delete" — so the two deletion sites are the target. But they serve different roles:
1. BackendLifecycle.Start.cs - deletes from VR's own repo (VR project root)
2. RelayTaskRepository.cs - deletes from any workspace VR drives

The six exclusion lists are not deletion — they're "skip" lists that protect the folder from being committed/filtered/reset — they should stay.

Also important: the current task is in skipTestsTaskIds, so we won't be running tests. But the existing tests (LegacyScratchCleanupTests, BackendLifecycleStatusTests) test deletion behavior that would break if deletions are removed.
